title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.93 (versions follow prime numbers; 593 after 587): one rule, the places, and what comes out of it builds what she answers. A place is what a word has beside it in a sentence (the word that counts before it, the word that counts after it); two words that share two places are of one kind. Nothing is named: what a person is, what someone does, whose child, are places as any other (Razar's sharpness, v0.3, now in her body and applied to what she is asked). Asked who Marianela is, with nobody having told her what a character is, what came out was Marianela, Nela, Florentina, Teodoro, Pablo. Those loose words are clues: among the sentences of her books about what she is asked she keeps the six that hold most of them, and says the one of most first. Seen in a hidden copy. With a book told in the first person it comes out weak; she chooses sentences and does not compose them yet; those questions take 11 to 31 seconds. Her logo is now the flag of Argentina. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
